note: The Bun plugin takes an `include` option, as the other plugins do, and compiles the published `.js` files of the listed packages. Before, only `.js` under `@devup-ui/` was loaded, so an uncompiled library's components threw `Cannot run on the runtime`. Each name matches that whole package, also in pnpm and Bun stores, and not the dependencies in its own `node_modules`
